source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of human-machine collaboration (PDF 189-190).

blocks.text: Human-machine collaboration (insaan aur machine ka mil kar kaam) ka matlab hai masle hal karne ke liye technology ke saath kaam karna. Is mein shamil hai:

items: Using Tools (tools istemal karna): Kaam mein madad ke liye software aur digital tools se faida uthayein. Misal: Students group project ke data ka tajziya karne ke liye spreadsheet software istemal kar sakte hain.

Combining Skills (salahiyatein milana): Behtar nataij ke liye insani salahiyat ko machine ki salahiyat ke saath milayein. Misal: Pecheeda (complex) data sets ko samajhne ke liye data analysis tools istemal karna, aur faisla karte waqt insani samajh (judgment) lagana.

blocks.prompt: Digital mahaul mein mil kar masle hal karne ki ahmiyat bataiye, aur misalon se samjhaiye ke human-machine collaboration is ko kaise behtar banata hai. (Long question 4)
blocks.explanation: Mil kar kaam karne se mukhtalif logon ki maharat ek jagah jama hoti hai aur mushtarka maqsad jaldi aur behtar tareeqe se haasil hota hai; digital tools ki madad se log saath kaam kar sakte hain aur research findings aur khayalat aasani se share kar sakte hain (7.6.4.2). Human-machine collaboration mein machine tez aur durust hisab kitab karti hai aur insaan samajh aur faisla lagata hai: 1) Using tools: students group project ke data ka tajziya spreadsheet software se karte hain. 2) Combining skills: data analysis tools pecheeda data sets ko samajhne mein madad dete hain, jab ke faisla insani judgment se hota hai. Is tarah dohraya jane wala aur lamba kaam machine karti hai aur log sochne aur faisle par dhyan dete hain, jis se nataij behtar hote hain.

items: Human-machine collaboration: tools istemal karna (spreadsheet), salahiyatein milana (data analysis tools + insani judgment).
